title: LeakSmart Sensor Alert Moisture Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume/Flo/HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=leaksmart:sensor moisture_pct=*
| stats sum(moisture_pct) as total_value, avg(moisture_pct) as avg_value by sensor_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks sensor values by total and average moisture percent across LeakSmart sensor alert events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `moisture_pct` values for each LeakSmart sensor alert event and review total and average moisture percent by sensor.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total moisture percent.
grandmaExplanation: It helps keep which sensor shows the biggest moisture percent numbers in your LeakSmart sensor alert data.
